context_condition: full two-file workspace in both languages; no edit-query arm and no query advantage claim
information_matching: identical mathematical task, target interfaces, provider obligations, public cases and hidden oracle per pair; language-specific syntax/profile instructions and original sources; all actual tokens charged
response: both complete file replacements in one strict files object; per-request decoder constrains envelope, exact filenames and content types only, never operations, constants, signatures or reference answers
task_origin: new task semantics and new held-out seed; finite arithmetic maintenance and API upgrades, not an external project corpus
cell_order: tasks in listed order; HIA then Rust when (task_index + model_index) is even, Rust then HIA otherwise

hidden.order: one state across tasks, three draws per random case; remove duplicates and public examples
hidden.feedback: never sent to the model; execute once after first public-pass submission; hidden failure is terminal

feedback: one compile/Core-check diagnostic plus three actual public cases, provider observations and expected public values; no manual repair
timeout_policy: timeout terminates that cell without an extra submission; retain raw partial evidence and unknown output usage; close and identity-check the owned server, start a new owned server before the next distinct cell; no suffix abort from a single transport timeout
infrastructure_policy: source/model/runtime/tool drift or native infrastructure failure invalidates the observation and halts; no substituted identity or retest-to-pass
provider_obligations: the submitted provider must independently return the required value, consumer must invoke it once with original a,b; Rust trusted native wrapper counter and direct native call; HIA actual same-Core VM trace plus separate native entrypoint, not a native HIA counter
admission: reuse exact prior hardened scalar admission, add acyclic HIA <=16 blocks and <=128 operations per function; no extra functions/resources; sealed executable snapshots with CPU2s, AS256MiB, wall5s

gates.per_family_per_stratum: all paired cells attempted and complete token usage; HIA succeeds in both tasks; HIA successes >= Rust; HIA aggregate input+output tokens <= Rust; HIA submissions <= Rust; HIA aggregate compile/public/hidden/boundary-identity validation ns <= Rust
gates.cross_family: both registered independent families pass the same stratum gate; no swapping models or tasks after outputs
gates.interpretation: finite descriptive pilot only, no population statistical superiority and no comprehensive economic-cost claim

costs: validated input/output token IDs and unknown timeout usage
scope_limits: no large project or external caller corpus
complete implicit system-library dependency closure not claimed
previous experiments are immutable and not rescored

models.provenance: official repository metadata captured before inference; different model size from previous 7B trial
same fixed official bytes retained from prior trial; new tasks and protocol
